column5: the assertion sits in a helper the check does not follow; a call it cannot see into is read as logic
a constant held equal to a file reads as two homes with no literal between them, which WORTH_SPARES_LOGIC_TESTS spares
a fixture parameter is opaque to a static reading, so a snapshot fixture reads as logic
toMatchSnapshot() holds no literal in the test; the literal lives in a snapshot file the runner writes
a name that names a regression is the author's declaration, and WORTH_SPARES_BUG_REGRESSIONS spares it
